metrics.method: Full history 2025-08-25 to 2026-10-08 (1,901 non-service messages: 1,122 from the client, 779 from our side). Client = 'LA Client' per config/clients.yaml; everyone else counts as our side, including the Lauryn vendor chat team, Melissa Userfacing, Mayson and Vivek. Computed with src/_tmp_lauryn-x-altr.py. client_questions_total = client messages containing '?'. unanswered_over_24h = 1 by the strict rule (no outbound message of any kind within 24h; 2026-07-19, 43.1h) plus 2 on-topic failures where other outbound traffic continued (the 09-02/03 Facebook chase, answered 12 days later and to a colleague; the 10-06 'I don't see the accounts', 39h until she sent '???'). Median first reply is 2 minutes, p90 3.2h. max_team_silence_days = longest gap between our outbound messages excluding leak/DMCA broadcasts (2025-12-05 to 2025-12-15). Counting all outbound messages the maximum is 8.1d; trailing silence at the run date is 0.7d. Promises = explicit, checkable commitments, with recurring cadences counted once each. Versus the 2026-09-25 run: +3 promises made (repost on 10-12, the 24h extension, re-sending the repost list); kept rose from 12 to 14 (leak cadence resumed, list re-sent); lapsed fell from 20 to 19. Two are still pending (repost on 10-12, enforcing or withdrawing the pause).

what_client_wanted: A working Facebook page with a real timeline. It supports her music career as well as OF, and it is the thing she has asked about most. 'It's very important for my page to be back up and functioning due to Business reasons 🙏🏽' (2026-08-18); 'So we have no time line / Is this normal to be slow like this ?? / 8 weeks in' (2026-09-28).

Momentum she can see in numbers. She tracks her own revenue closely. 'Let's make this impactful 🚀🚀🚀' (2025-08-25); 'last month was def short our LOWEST money wise' (2026-03-28); 'My books are ran off what drops after pending state' (2026-07-30).
Her brand and her limits protected without having to argue for them again. 'Just def want page protected at all costs' (2025-09-15); 'No exception for him / Just something I won't do' (2026-02-24).
To be told things instead of having to chase them. 'Keep me updated Mama 💜💜💜' (2025-09-27); 'Keep me updated pls / Well I'm periodically checking on my end as well' (2026-08-18).
what_worked: The DMCA/leak service is the most durable source of trust, and it is running again (09-25, 10-02). 'Insaneeee / But glad we cleaned it all up / Thank Youuuu 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽' (2025-08-28); 'Wewww / Thank you for the update 🙏🏽' (2025-09-03). Keep it weekly and never let it lapse silently.

Visible growth actions get immediate engagement. She replied to the repost-network notice the same day: 'I see my reel tho 🙏🏽' (2026-10-06). When the 30-day report and game plan were sent, she answered 'I think we are on the right track / Moving Upward 📈 / Stradgey makes sense' (2025-09-23). She responds to proof of effort.

Protecting her with fans and asking about boundaries before taking requests. Tanya pausing chatting during her live events got 'Perfect!! / Thank youuu 💜💜' (2025-12-20). King Choy setting expectations first got 'Thank Youuu / For communicating that with me 🙏🏽🙏🏽🙏🏽' (2025-08-30).
top_fix: Give this account one named internal owner, accountable for a standing fortnightly update, and escalate if it slips. The update should cover revenue and subscribers, Facebook status with a real owner, case number and next date, what was paid and what is still owed, and every open ask on both sides. It goes out whether or not there is good news. Every severe finding here comes from the same gap: when Sophie left on 2025-10-09, nobody took over the job of telling Lauryn anything she had not chased herself. That is why the call she asked for disappeared, why the Facebook page has gone 377 days without a timeline, why the only senior voice in her chat is a payment chase plus a pause threat, and why we cannot confirm what her 10-08 payment covered.
